title: A trip for two
titleJp: {二人|ふたり}で{旅行|りょこう}

canDos.text: Plan a short trip: say where you plan to go, how long you'll stay and what you want to see.
Read a ryokan or hotel information sheet (check-in time, meals, bath hours) and answer questions about it.
Understand a friend's travel tips and what they've heard about a place (the food's great, it's crowded in autumn).
Explain politely why you need something at a hotel or station, and make a request ('It's our first time here, so…').
Write a postcard-style message about your trip: where you went, what was great and what wasn't.

task.goal: Plan a two-night trip: share what you each know about two places and agree where to go, how to get there and where to stay.

roles.a: Has the guide page for a hot-spring town (card A)
roles.b: Has the guide page for a seaside town and your budget (card B)

capstone.title: Our trip
capstone.brief: Act out a trip from planning to coming home: decide where you plan to go and for how long, pass on what friends said about it, check in politely at a ryokan with a request, and on the way home talk about what was great and what wasn't.
